mapper.select: SELECT * FROM limited_campaign WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id AS id, c.product_id AS product_id, p.application_id AS application_id, a.name AS application_name, p.title AS product_title, p.subtitle AS product_subtitle, p.rules AS product_rules, p.model_version AS model_version, p.image_size AS image_size, p.price AS price, p.credits AS credits, p.valid_days AS valid_days, p.output_count AS output_count, c.begin_at AS begin_at, c.end_at AS end_at, c.remaining_stock AS remaining_stock, c.publish_state AS publish_state FROM limited_campaign c JOIN usage_product p ON p.id = c.product_id JOIN ai_application a ON a.id = p.application_id WHERE c.published_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.begin_at DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id AS id, c.product_id AS product_id, p.application_id AS application_id, a.name AS application_name, p.title AS product_title, p.subtitle AS product_subtitle, p.rules AS product_rules, p.model_version AS model_version, p.image_size AS image_size, p.price AS price, p.credits AS credits, p.valid_days AS valid_days, p.output_count AS output_count, c.begin_at AS begin_at, c.end_at AS end_at, c.remaining_stock AS remaining_stock, c.publish_state AS publish_state FROM limited_campaign c JOIN usage_product p ON p.id = c.product_id JOIN ai_application a ON a.id = p.application_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.published_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.id AS id, c.product_id AS product_id, p.application_id AS application_id, a.name AS application_name, p.title AS product_title, p.price AS price, p.credits AS credits, p.valid_days AS valid_days, c.initial_stock AS initial_stock, c.remaining_stock AS remaining_stock, c.begin_at AS begin_at, c.end_at AS end_at, c.publish_state AS publish_state, c.generation AS generation, c.published_at AS published_at, c.created_at AS created_at FROM limited_campaign c JOIN usage_product p ON p.id = c.product_id JOIN ai_application a ON a.id = p.application_id ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT c.id AS id, c.product_id AS product_id, p.application_id AS application_id, a.name AS application_name, p.title AS product_title, p.price AS price, p.credits AS credits, p.valid_days AS valid_days, c.initial_stock AS initial_stock, c.remaining_stock AS remaining_stock, c.begin_at AS begin_at, c.end_at AS end_at, c.publish_state AS publish_state, c.generation AS generation, c.published_at AS published_at, c.created_at AS created_at FROM limited_campaign c JOIN usage_product p ON p.id = c.product_id JOIN ai_application a ON a.id = p.application_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE limited_campaign SET publish_state = 'ACTIVE', published_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND publish_state = 'DRAFT' AND published_at IS NULL
UPDATE campaign_generation SET status = 'ACTIVE', rebuilt_at = NOW(3) WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND generation = #{generation} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaign_generation(campaign_id, generation, status, remaining_stock) VALUES (#{campaignId}, #{generation}, #{status}, #{remainingStock})
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign_generation SET status = 'REPLACED', replaced_at = NOW(3) WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND generation <> #{replacement}
UPDATE limited_campaign SET remaining_stock = remaining_stock - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND remaining_stock > 0
UPDATE limited_campaign SET remaining_stock = remaining_stock + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND remaining_stock < initial_stock
